channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brandon Roy | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brandon Roy from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Brandon Roy
item.description:
“I know that’s saying a lot, but B Roy was definitely in that tier when he was playing.”

Kevin Durant on Brandon Roy, Jan 7, 2026. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Paul George on Brandon Roy, Jamal Crawford
item.description:
“He's got shades of off the bounce stuff like Jamal Crawford. He's got the scoring ability like Brandon Roy... He's scary NOW.”

Paul George on Brandon Roy, Jamal Crawford, Nov 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Brandon Roy
item.description:
“Justto be moving up on that list period, but I mean, if Brandon Roy got to play as long as he should have played and people would have liked to see him play I probably would never pass him.”

Damian Lillard on Brandon Roy, Feb 11, 2016. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy
item.description:
“He kind of doubted himself a little, especially when Brandon got off to a good start,”

Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Apr 25, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Greg Oden
item.description:
“They needed to look at rebuilding before that thing crumbled. And they needed to look at everything, including the head coaching position. With some guys, I knew it wasn’t part of their plan to be there. We had two of our core players — Brandon (Roy) and Greg (Oden) — basically retire. So I told him that he needed to get something for the guys we had, he needed to look at redoing this whole thing before it crumbles.”

Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Greg Oden, Nov 30, 2013. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Will Conroy on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Conroy is close to Wolves president of basketball operations David Kahn, who asked Conroy to put in a few words for him when Roy was attracting interest from other NBA teams.

“I told Brandon I know Kahn and he's trying to change the culture in Minnesota,”

Will Conroy on Brandon Roy, Oct 10, 2012. Source: St. Paul Pioneer Press.

item.title: Glen Taylor on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Glen Taylor:

“Brandon Roy, you might think that is the coach, but that is more David. I think it is David saying, ‘Let give this player to Rick and get the backup in place in case it doesn’t work out.’ Because Rick keeps saying to me, ‘I don’t know if he can play!’ And I tell him, ‘Rick, I don’t know if he can play either!’ So the Brandon Roy thing is a risk.”

Glen Taylor on Brandon Roy, Oct 1, 2012. Source: Minnesota Post.

item.title: Kevin Love on Andrei Kirilenko, Brandon Roy, Chase Budinger
item.description:
“Actually, in the past few weeks I think they've done a great job. I like who we've added with Brandon Roy, with Chase Budinger, with Andrei Kirilenko now — some veteran guys who know how to play,”

Kevin Love on Andrei Kirilenko, Brandon Roy, Chase Budinger, Jul 27, 2012. Source: USA Today.

item.title: Bob Myers on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Bob Myers:

“I told (Roy) when he was amnesty-ed … ‘I hope this isn’t it for you. Make sure this isn’t it. He’s said publicly he wants to come back, so I’ll start to talk to him. It depends how everything goes for us and what his expectations are and all of that. But absolutely I’ll talk to him.”

Bob Myers on Brandon Roy, Jun 22, 2012. Source: CSNBayArea.com.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Adam Morrison, Michael Jordan, Brandon Roy
item.description:
When Jordan told him the Bobcats were eyeing Gonzaga star Adam Morrison with the third overall pick of the 2006 draft, Barkley said he questioned his friend on the decision.

“I said 'Michael, I think you should take Brandon Roy, and he said 'We like Adam Morrison,'”

Charles Barkley on Adam Morrison, Michael Jordan, Brandon Roy, Mar 1, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Jamal Crawford on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Jamal Crawford:

“I think so. No question about it. One thing about Brandon is that Brandon's a very loyal person, he knows the fans out there absolutely adore him, he adores them. Brandon loves the fans and loves the city of Portland. I remember in Seattle a lot of times, all the guys are usually there in summer, he's like 'I'm just going to stay in Portland for a week' or 'I'm going to be up in Portland for a few days.' I definitely think he'll come back whenever he's ready.”

Jamal Crawford on Brandon Roy, Jan 13, 2012. Source: Blazers Edge.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Kobe on B. Roy:

“I'm very sad for Brandon. We've had some great battles here... Phenomenal talent... I hope it's not the end for him.”

Kobe Bryant on Brandon Roy, Jan 6, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Chad Buchanan on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Chad Buchanan told me after the press conference...

“There would have to be a drastic change in where we are at right now, or where Brandon feels he's at, to have something be altered as to where we stand today.”

Chad Buchanan on Brandon Roy, Dec 6, 2011. Source: Blazers Edge.

item.title: Larry Miller on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Miller said interim general manager Chad Buchanan called Roy's agent at 6 a.m. this morning -- the earliest team officials could contact agents -- to arrange a meeting with Roy.

“With everything that Brandon has done for this organization, there's no way we would make a decision like that without having conversation with him, without evaluating where he is,”

Larry Miller on Brandon Roy, Dec 1, 2011. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Wesley Matthews on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Wesley Matthews on Brandon Roy:

“He put us on his back. He's still brandon roy. He still has plenty of basketball in him.”

Wesley Matthews on Brandon Roy, Nov 28, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy
item.description:
coach Nate McMillan said.

“I said this to you guys before, and I will say it again, there's nobody in this state, not even Brandon Roy, who wants to see him on the floor as much as I do. He has meant a lot to this organization. I certainly have not forgotten about him.”

Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Apr 22, 2011. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Patty Mills on Brandon Roy
item.description:
It started a new road tradition of having the lockers of Roy and Mills side-by-side, and it helped strengthen an already tight bond.

“When I first came into the league, Brandon and LaMarcus took under wing and showed me the ropes,”

Patty Mills on Brandon Roy, Apr 22, 2011. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy
item.description:
He said that he had not read the story but had spoken to Roy about it.

“I said to Brandon, there's nobody in this state, including Brandon, that (wants) Brandon on the floor as much as I do,”

Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Apr 21, 2011. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy
item.description:
McMillan said the change has been a major transition for him, too.

“It's a challenge every time I call Brandon's name off the bench,”

Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Apr 21, 2011. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy
item.description:
“That's our All-Star. We're going through a season where we are trying to figure out what he can do and how he can help the team and get him through this year. But I know what he has done for this organization. And to call Brandon Roy's name as a backup is different.”

Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Apr 21, 2011. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy
item.description:
Roy playing this weekend.

“We have to [take a cautious approach] ... Brandon has been cleared to practice, he has been doing some running on his own, shooting when the team has been out of town. He has been cleared to practice, there is no set date or game for him to return.”

Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Feb 9, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.
